fem.text: Icatia, the human nation of Sarpadia, loses Farrel and his followers, who formally break their ties after the fall of Trokair.
The Icatian army easily repels early orc surprise attacks on border towns like Montford, and the Phalanxes fight on even after the wall is breached in half a dozen places.
Weakened by the Farrelite Cult, Icatia finally falls to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, the last of the Sarpadian empires to fall.
